_meta.name: English
_meta.prompt: When requested to translate a localization file, follow the rules in this prompt. _meta.prompt must not be changed. _meta.name must be in the requested language, not English. For example, it should be 日本語 in the Japanese language. _meta.variant must be the model used, for example GPT-5 or Gemini 3; of course, substitute with the LLM model in use. The words Unity, GameObject, NDMF, NDMF Preview, and LightboxViewer are technical terms so they must remain in English.

phrases.msg_play_mode_requires_pre_activation: To use LightboxViewer in Play mode, activate it before entering Play mode.
phrases.msg_lightbox_scene_modified:
You have modified the lightbox scene.
Do you want to save the lightbox scene?
phrases.msg_post_processing_missing:
Post-processing is missing from the project.
Install post-processing?
phrases.ndmf_preview_tooltip:
Render the result of NDMF Preview instead of the original object. Renderers whose bones are changed by the preview are rendered as they are in the scene.

Disabled: render the original object.
Slow updates: only render the complete result that NDMF Preview shows, and do not render while NDMF Preview computes a new result.
Aggressive updates: render the result as soon as it changes, which may show the object without the result for a few frames (e.g. while editing a material).
phrases.msg_invalid_lightbox_scene: Lightbox scene has no root GameObject named "Lightboxes", or it is empty.
